title: Jefferson Memorial Aerial View, Washington D.C., 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An aerial black-and-white photograph depicting the Thomas Jefferson Memorial situated along the Tidal Basin in Washington, D.C., taken on June 4, 1949. The elevated perspective shows the neoclassical monument surrounded by water, green spaces, and nearby bridges crossing the Potomac River. Dedicated only a few years prior in 1943 during World War II, the landmark represented American democratic ideals during the early Cold War era.
